text.t:
The ithos®️ wooden children's lamp, with its delicate whale silhouette, combines timeless design, cosy light and the charm of small details. Its warm white LED lighting creates a soft and comforting atmosphere, ideal for accompanying moments of reading, tranquillity and snugness before sleep.

During the day, it serves as a decorative piece that adds personality and tenderness to the children's bedroom. With careful finishes and hand-painted details, it integrates harmoniously into environments inspired by nature, soft woods and neutral tones.
Created to make rest times even sweeter and more special.
